title: Light of the World: Selected Tablets of ‘Abdu’l‑Bahá
textType: Authoritative text and recorded talk of ‘Abdu’l‑Bahá
author: abdul-baha
attributionNote: Light of the World: Selected Tablets of ‘Abdu’l‑Bahá, by ‘Abdu’l‑Bahá: the Bahá’í Reference Library's own record of the work, on its ‘Abdu’l‑Bahá shelf.
description: Tablets of ‘Abdul-Bahá describing aspects of the life of Bahá’u’lláh including the tribulations He suffered, events in His homeland, the purpose and greatness of His Cause, and the nature and significance of His Covenant. The record was created by the Bahá’í import from the Reference Library's own catalogue and reading views; the summary above is the library's own description of the work, and an editor's note for the work itself is still to be written.
historicalContext: Read in the Bahá’í Reference Library, in the section where the Bahá’í International Community publishes the authorised English text (‘Abdu’l‑Bahá).
availabilityNote: Complete as the Reference Library publishes it: the library's reading views for this work are streamed from bahai.org at read time, one chapter at a time, with the Community's copyright notice. The chapters are the divisions of the library's own reading text; the publication's front matter and its notes are not imported.
